decisions.reason: It is very close to the firm’s existing dental practice software and digitalisation path, so the firm can use its domain knowledge, customer feedback, and in-house R&D to improve and commercialise it effectively.

The education institute builds on the firm’s practitioner relationships and training capabilities, strengthens customer attachment to the core software business, and fits its ability to absorb and apply user knowledge from the dental field.

A remote screen sharing support tool directly complements the firm’s established support and software activities, making it easy to integrate into existing routines and learn from early usage to raise service quality.
